notes.title: Level Contest - Ascent
notes.notes:
[p]Season 7: Theme 1  [/p][h3][b]THEME:[/b] Ascent[/h3][p]Build a level where each checkpoint is vertically higher than the previous checkpoint.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking for ideas? How about a mountain climb course; an adventurous course up a volcano; or a track climbing up a skyscraper![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions, feel free to ask them in the discussion thread of this news post! Good luck, and happy building! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]DEADLINE[/b][/h3][list][*][p] Your track should be complete and submitted by [b]Sunday, 21st September 2025 at 18:00 BST[/b][/p][/*][*][p] Submissions will be combined into a single workshop item after the deadline above [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]SUBMISSION RULES[/b][/h3][olist][*][p] You can only submit one level[/p][list][*][p]You can modify or replace your submission as much as you like until the deadline[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] Level collaborations are permitted[/p][list][*][p]Maximum of 3 players per level[/p][/*][*][p]This counts as a level submission for each individual creator[/p][/*][*][p]Please add collaborators in the collaborators text field of the Level Editor level settings and mention them when submitting the level[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] Level author name [b]MUST[/b] contain the submitters' Steam (or Discord) username[/p][/*][*][p] The name of the level [b]MUST[/b] start with "ZSL - " (e.g "ZSL - My Level")[/p][/*][*][p] Your submission [b]MUST[/b] be created within the 3 week building period. Please do not re-upload older maps—even if they fit the theme! [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]THEME RULES[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Every checkpoint [b]MUST[/b] be placed at a higher altitude than the previous checkpoint[/p][list][*][p]If you use Linked Checkpoints, each linked checkpoint must also be higher than the previous checkpoint. However, linked checkpoints within the same group do [b]not [/b]need to match each other's height[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The finish block [b]MUST [/b]be placed at a higher altitude than all other checkpoints[/p][/*][*][p]The player is allowed to descend/go downward between checkpoints. The ascent restriction only applied to the checkpoints themselves[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]LEVEL RULES[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Scaling track pieces is permitted[/p][/*][*][p]Level [b]MUST[/b] follow any theme requirements set above[/p][/*][*][p]Level [b]MUST[/b] be [b]under 3000 blocks [/b][u](adjusted for Season 7)[/u][/p][/*][*][p]Level [b]MUST[/b] have an author time [b]above 25 seconds [/b][u](adjusted for Season 7)[/u][/p][/*][*][p]Level [b]MUST[/b] have an author time [b]under 60 seconds[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Level [b]MUST[/b] have [b][i]at least[/i] 3 checkpoints[/b]. [/p][list][*][p]Consider adding additional checkpoints for split timing or where it would prevent a cut, as cuts do not make for good tournament tracks![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Level [b]MUST NOT[/b] have risky or hidden finishes/shortcuts[/p][list][*][p]e.g blind shortcuts or using no-collision/invisible/logic blocks to hide a secret path that is [b]NOT[/b] the intended route. This includes hidden linked checkpoints.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p] [/p][h3][b]HOW TO SUBMIT YOUR LEVEL[/b][/h3][olist][*][p] Join our [url="https://discord.com/servers/zeepkist-706615492634476664"]Official Discord server[/url][/p][/*][*][p] Upload the level to the Steam Workshop[/p][/*][*][p] Link the workshop item in the [url="https://discord.com/channels/706615492634476664/1391528067029008474"]theme's thread in [b]#level-submissions[/b][/url][/p][/*][/olist][p]Don't have Discord? You can submit your entry by linking your workshop item in the comments section of this announcement post![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]WINNERS & PRIZES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Up to 15 levels will be featured in the monthly Zeepkist Super League tournament; picked by our judging panel[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The community will vote on their favourite maps from the theme once submissions close[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Creators of the 4 best decorated and 4 best track design/flow will win the Season 7 Level Contest cosmetic. [/p][/*][*][p]Winners who are Zeepkist Discord members will additionally:[/p][list][*][p]Receive 6,000 XP on the Discord server[/p][/*][*][p]Receive a role reward for the round won[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]  [/p][h3][b]WHAT MAKES A LEVEL FUN TO RACE[/b][/h3][p]To give your level the best chance of being one of the up to 15 levels selected for the monthly Zeepkist Super League tournament by our panel of judges, focus on creating a track that is enjoyable to race. Keep these points in mind while building and testing your level:[/p][list][*][p][b]Enjoyability:[/b] Is your level fun to drive? Focus on smooth, flowing racing lines that are satisfying to drive. Add interesting twists, jumps or obstacles that make the track exciting without creating frustration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Learnability:[/b] Can players of all skill levels pick up your level and complete it in a reasonable time? The Super League is open to everyone, so try to design your level so both newcomers and experienced racers can enjoy it and have a chance to set a time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Theme Fit:[/b] Make sure the level fits the theme requirements[/p][/*][/list][p]Levels are judged on their own merits, not based on who built them.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]BANNER CONTEST[/b][/h3][p]We're also hosting a themed banner contest for our Discord server banner image where you can win the brand new Banner Contest cosmetic for Season 7!!   [/p][p]The theme is [b]Ascent[/b] and ends at the same time as this level contest!! [url="https://discord.com/channels/706615492634476664/1034982513304666222"]View the banner contest event details on Discord[/url]

- Akane[/p]

notes.title: Zeepkist Super League: The Gauntlet II
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/c7d732333ffa3b8a07f76e6f39dadbd7ae693303.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]🏆[i]The Gauntlet II[/i] – A Special Edition of the Zeepkist Super League![/h1][p]
[b]1,574 levels. 64 players. 10 winners. 90 minutes.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Join us on [b]Sunday, September 14th, 2025, at 18:00 BST[/b] for [i]The Gauntlet II[/i]—a Super League event celebrating the start of [b]Season 7![/b] This is your chance to [b]win[/b] [b]exclusive contest cosmetics[/b] from[b] Seasons 1–6[/b] (Super League, Level Contests, and Banner Contests) before we switch to the brand-new Season 7 & 8 rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2]📅 Event Details[/h2][list][*][p][b]Date:[/b] Sunday, September 14th 2025[/p][/*][*][p][b]Time:[/b] 10:00 PDT / 13:00 EDT / 18:00 BST / 19:00 CEST[/p][/*][*][p][b]Capacity:[/b] [b]64 players[/b] (first-come, first-served)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Room Opens:[/b] 17:40 BST (20 minutes before start)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Duration:[/b] [b]Ends when we reach 10 winners or after 90 minutes[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]💡 Due to the special format, there is no second timeslot.[/p][p][/p][h2]🏁 Event Format[/h2][list][*][p][b]64 players[/b] compete in a single room.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Random shuffled levels[/b] from every Level Contest submission since November 2022.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Each round lasts 3m45s[/b] — after a player sets a time, the timer drops to [b]60s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Championship Points system:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🥇 1st: 30pts[/p][/*][*][p]🥈 2nd: 27pts[/p][/*][*][p]🥉 3rd: 24pts[/p][/*][*][p]4th: 22pts[/p][/*][*][p]5th: 20pts[/p][/*][*][p]6th: 18pts[/p][/*][*][p]7th: 16pts[/p][/*][*][p]8th: 14pts[/p][/*][*][p]9th: 12pts[/p][/*][*][p]10th: 10pts[/p][/*][*][p]11th-16th: 6pts[/p][/*][*][p]17th-32nd: 4pts[/p][/*][*][p]33rd-64th: 2pts[/p][/*][*][p]❌ DNF: 0pts
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]🥇 How to Win[/h2][list][*][p]Reach [b]300 championship points[/b] to become a [b]Finalist[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]Once you become a [b]Finalist[/b], you must [b]win a round[/b] to claim one of [b]10 winner spots[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After winning, you stop earning points and no longer appear on leaderboards.[/p][/*][*][p]The event ends once [b]10 winners are decided[/b] or after [b]90 minutes[/b] (whichever comes first).[/p][/*][/list][p]💡 If the 90 minute time limit is reached before all 10 winners are decided, the event ends early.[/p][p][/p][p]Results will be shared on the [b]Official Zeepkist Discord[/b] and in the discussion thread of this post[i]. Full results may be made available on [/i][url="https://zeepki.st"]zeepki.st[/url][i] at a later date.[/i] [/p][p] [/p][h2]🎁 Prizes[/h2][p]
Each of the 10 winners can pick [b]one[/b] of these 9 exclusive cosmetics:[/p][p][/p][h3]Super League Cosmetics[/h3][list][*][p][b]Season 1 & 2:[/b] Black Racing Helmet with Wicked Visor[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 3 & 4:[/b] White/Black Racing Helmet with Wicked Visor + Cat Ears[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 5 & 6:[/b] Berghammer Jolley '13 (ZSL Colour Scheme) [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/da44077478f40c0bc26ed7a5f2e495835ffccb9c.png"][/img][/p][h3]Level Contest Cosmetics[/h3][list][*][p][b]Season 1 & 2:[/b] Black Builder Helmet with Wicked Trim[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 3 & 4:[/b] White Builder Helmet with Wicked Trim + Cat Ears [/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 5 & 6:[/b] Test Soapbox (Blueprint Version)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/41789f601fbaad25a5cfd7ad07fec2b5728fa259.png"][/img][/p][h3]Banner Contest Cosmetics[/h3][list][*][p][b]Season 1 & 2:[/b] Black Beret with Paint Brush[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 3 & 4:[/b] Red Tartan Beret with Paint Brush[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 5 & 6:[/b] Paintbrush Soapbox with Wicked Paint[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/1c19c3c74cdbce0c425bb9d287c7fda4550a2c2d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🔔 Winners will be contacted via Discord or Steam after the event to confirm choices.[/p][p][/p][p]ℹ️ [b]Already own all 9 contest cosmetics?[/b] You’ll be [b]eliminated once you reach Finalist[/b] and won't be able to claim a winner spot. Affected players will be contacted before the event.[/p][p][/p][h2]🎮 How to Join[/h2][p][/p][p]The Super League is open to everyone! Just launch Zeepkist and look for the room hosted by Akane:[/p][p][/p][p]🔹 [b]Zeepkist Super League: The Gauntlet II[/b][/p][p][/p][p]💡 Rooms are first-come, first-served — arrive early to secure your spot![/p][p][/p][h2]🎲 What Tracks Are We Racing On?[/h2][p]We'll be racing on a [b]random selection[/b] from the [b]1,574 Level Contest submissions[/b] across Seasons 1–6:[/p][list][*][p][b]Season 1:[/b] 250 levels (9 excluded)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 2:[/b] 360 levels (13 excluded)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 3:[/b] 224 levels (9 excluded)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 4:[/b] 237 levels (8 excluded)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 5:[/b] 224 levels (2 excluded)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season 6:[/b] 279 levels[/p][/*][/list][p]Only [b]1-3%[/b] of these tracks will be played — will one of your submissions get chosen?[/p][p]🔗 Find the full Super League workshop collection here: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2911644976"]https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2911644976[/url] [/p][p][/p][h2]📌 Track Selection Notice[/h2][list][*][p]41 tracks randomly selected during the first Gauntlet are excluded from the pool for The Gauntlet II.[/p][/*][*][p]This event features every submitted Level Contest track, not just the 15 tracks selected by our panel of judges for each round.[/p][/*][*][p]Expect a wide mix: some highly polished, some creative experiments and occasionally some jank or unusual challenges![/p][/*][*][p]We may skip a track if needed to keep the tournament flowing (e.g. extreme difficulty, RNG-heavy tracks or broken tracks)[/p][/*][/list][p]Be ready for anything — and most importantly, [b]have fun![/b][/p][p] [/p][h2]💬 Questions?[/h2][list][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/v8RDd7C7Vt"]Join the Zeepkist Discord[/url] and head to the [b]#super-league[/b] announcement channel[/p][/*][*][p]Or post in the discussion thread for this announcement[/p][/*][/list][p]🙏 Special thanks to [b]Agix[/b], creator of the [b]Top→Out tournament system[/b] powering The Gauntlet. No mods required to play![/p][p][/p][p]  – Akane[/p]

notes.title: Help Shape Zeepkist Season 7 – Feedback & Judge Sign-ups
notes.notes: [h1]Season 6 Feedback Submission Is Open![/h1][p]Season 6 of Zeepkist’s community events wrapped up on August 10th with the Deserts & Dunes Super League finale. [/p][p]Now it’s your turn to shape what’s next — share your feedback and help us prepare for Season 7, launching at the end of August![/p][p][/p][h2]Level Contest & Banner Contest Feedback[/h2][p]Got feedback on the [b]monthly Level Contests[/b] or the [b]Discord Banner Contests[/b]?[/p][p]Tell us what you enjoyed, what could be better, and what new ideas you’d like to see next season.[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/Ma8pNwQjPa4ZnUS9A" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff8040"]Submit Level & Banner Contest Feedback[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Super League Tournament Feedback[/h2][p]The [b]Zeepkist Super League (ZSL)[/b] brings together up to 15 community-made contest levels each month.[/p][p]We want your thoughts on the format, scoring, and overall experience to make Season 7 even better![/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/Vxky9uSkuXRATQRp9" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff8040"]Submit Super League Feedback[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Become a Judge for Season 7[/h2][p]We’re refreshing the [b]entire judging panel[/b] — so everyone, new or returning, must apply! You'll be joining a panel of around 20 judges.[/p][p][b]What do judges do?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play and review Level Contest submissions[/p][/*][*][p]Nominate up to 15 entries to help decide which tracks appear in ZSL[/p][/*][*][p]Aim to contribute to at least 3 rounds across the season[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Who can apply?[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Anyone! Builders, racers or both — all skill levels welcome[/p][/*][*][p]Being a judge does not exclude you from entering the Level Contest [b](you just can't nominate your own or collab levels)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://forms.gle/vGBJzQp4YsDpStVk8" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff8040"]Apply to be a Judge[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Super League Results Are Back Online[/h2][p]The community-run [url="https://zeepki.st/super-league"]zeepki.st/super-league[/url] site has returned as [b]ZeepCentraal[/b], covering results from [/p][p][b]Season 1 through Season 6[/b]![/p][p]Now you can view [i]per-level standings[/i] for each round — which was never shown on the old site.[/p][p][i]Note: events since the Zeepkist V17 update (new level format) do not have per-level standings. Work is underway to add full compatibility in ZeepCentraal.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Zeepkist Beautiful Beta - Version 17, Patch 15-17
notes.notes: [h1]Hey everyone!![/h1][p][/p][p]Just wanted to throw an update out there while I keep working on v18: Logic 2.0.[/p][p][/p][p]For this update I've enabled the new connection tool in the editor, and although logic itself is not yet done, you can already use this on checkpoints to connect and link them![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/614b66c0e163b8200d13d0046a0c79e1aad94343.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]When checkpoints are linked, they will act as if they are one checkpoint.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/50a3165a4d37867f7e377404d751e94366dfd64e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The connection tool also has a useful tooltip text that pops up whenever you hover over block's connection nodes, which will come in especially useful with later updates, when multiple types of connection nodes will exist.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/260d9ed599b2e3670597feb800448713812cf72d.png"][/img][/p][p]I've also added a few blocks to patch 15 for builders to play with :)[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 15:[/p][list][*][p]added connection tool[/p][/*][*][p]added linking checkpoints with connection tool[/p][/*][*][p]added trash can block[/p][/*][*][p]added bug[/p][/*][*][p]author names with overridename are now displayed in italics[/p][/*][*][p]added flat bumpy grass (10 size variants)[/p][/*][*][p]added witch hat block[/p][/*][*][p]added editable wooden signs with arrows, and wooden signs without support posts[/p][/*][*][p]awarded a lot of contest items[/p][/*][*][p]fixed trees 1544 and 1528[/p][/*][*][p]added hollow cube and hollow sphere primitives[/p][/*][*][p]added deadly spike[/p][/*][*][p]added 2 cool new tube pieces[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Patch 16:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed broken block 1291[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Patch 17:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a Ctrl-Z issue where deleted blocks would not reappear[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Happy Zeepkisting!!!![/p]

notes.title: Zeepkist Super League - 80 Blocks
notes.notes:
[h1][i]Season 6: Round 5[/i] — 80 Blocks[/h1][p]

notes.title: BUG WARNING: Online Workshop Level Issue
notes.notes: [h1]HELLO EVERYONE[/h1][p][/p][h3]TL;DR:[/h3][p][b]Newly uploaded workshop levels can't be played online, the level download function on the server returns with an error code that says "fail".[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]It does not do this for existing workshop levels, only workshop levels that got uploaded after June 20, it appears.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]I strongly suspect this is an issue on Steam's end, and I have opened a support ticket and I'm awaiting their reply.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Long version:[/h3][p]So last friday, the 21st, someone on my Discord made a bug report that they couldn't play their newly uploaded workshop level.[/p][p][/p][p]At first I expected this to be a fluke, a weird accident, so I tried it out myself. I made a new level, uploaded it to the workshop, and tried to load it online.[/p][p][/p][p]Nothing. I got an error that said "failed to load level".[/p][p][/p][p]That was strange, so I dove into the server log.[/p][p][/p][p]The way Zeepkist loads levels online is the client (you, the player) sends a Workshop ID to the server, which the server then downloads from Steam, and passes back to the players. This ensures everyone has the exact same level at all times, and it's quicker than having each player individually download workshop levels on their local computer (which also gave other issues in the past).[/p][p][/p][p]So Zeepkist does this by calling a function called [b]DownloadItem[/b]. DownloadItem then returns true or false, as well as an error code called [b]EResult[/b]. In the case of my newly uploaded level, it returned the following error code:[/p][p][/p][p][b]2 - k_EResultFail[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The download just failed, whereas all other existing levels worked fine.[/p][p][/p][p]I searched the Steam API for further clues, and it described [b]2 - k_EResultFail[/b] as follows:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Generic failure.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Super duper useful (not).[/p][p][/p][p]It was at this point that I felt out of options, and I opened a Steam support ticket. It was just the beginning of the weekend so nobody on Steam's end has been online yet.[/p][p][/p][p][b]As of writing I'm still waiting for their reply, and I'll keep you informed of course.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I did some further digging, because the Zeepkist server also keeps special "Steam Workshop Logs". In those, I again found my level's Workshop ID, and found the following errors:[/p][p][/p][p][b]unpack failed (suspended)[/b][/p][p][b]unpack failed (corrupt download)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I updated my support request with these new findings.[/p][p][/p][p]All I know is the following:[/p][list][*][p]I did not change anything[/p][/*][*][p]From one moment to the next, certain workshop levels stopped working[/p][/*][*][p]Rebooting the server did not fix it[/p][/*][*][p]The server has not run out of storage space (this happened once, I wrote a fix for it)[/p][/*][*][p]Workshop levels clearly still work, because the server will download old existing levels happily and fine[/p][/*][*][p]For some reason, there's one user on the Discord who seems unaffected by the whole thing, and he can upload new levels fine & everyone can play them fine in online[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I [i]strongly[/i] suspect Steam broke a tiny little thing on their workshop download servers, but I have no way to confirm that of course. I'll need to wait for support to get back to me.[/p][p][/p][p]For the time being, all we can do is wait.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, I'm going to carefully start researching ways to circumvent Steam workshop downloading altogether, but I can't make any promises here yet.[/p][p][/p][p]I will keep you informed of developments as they unfold.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm sorry for the inconvenience :([/p][p][/p][p]- Yannic[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 17 - The Skybox Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone!!![/h1]

Today it's time for some Zeepkist v17!!!!!!!!

[b]THE SKYBOX UPDATE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/3c949e9cd4204d2bc8c08e5aec52c0b83b79f164.png[/img]


[h1]MOD WARNING[/h1]

[b]IF YOU HAVE ANY MODS, THIS UPDATE WILL LIKELY BREAK THEM - IF YOU RUN INTO ANY ISSUES, REMOVE ALL MODS AND SEE IF THE ISSUES PERSIST[/b]


[h1]The Skybox Update[/h1]

The skybox update is a pretty technically comprehensive update, because it doesn't just add cool skybox customization - it also completely rewrites the way Zeepkist handles levels.

Before v17, Zeepkist saved levels as [b]csv[/b] files (Comma Separated Values). This had a whole bunch of drawbacks and I'm honestly not completely sure why I ever made it like that to begin with.

Anyway, NOW Zeepkist saves levels as [b]json[/b] files!! This should give me a looot more flexibility when it comes to what I can save in the level file.

To demonstrate the power of this change, I made it so you can now make entirely custom skyboxes, using the exact same options I've had at my disposal when I made all the preset skyboxes.


[h1]Some JSON Details[/h1]

All of your old levels will still work! I wrote the code in a way that Zeepkist is 100% backwards compatible with all pre-v17 levels. You can still load them in singleplayer, online, and the level editor.

Any level you save from here on out though, will be saved in the new JSON format! :)


[h1]The Skybox Editor[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/334b8cc1b85cf2a8bd7dd17830e550464bf4523b.jpg[/img]

In the level editor, you will see a new button that looks like a lightbulb:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/7af34fbab05c12bf84ce59614b74c25ffe9f5cad.png[/img]


This takes you to the Skybox Editor:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/692d5108d1dfdb15954726320b08babcf5af823f.png[/img]


From where you have many many pages of all sorts of options allowing you to create the skybox of your dreams! :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/5ae9cbb97b838be3255bc2371b741a6e9a12516c.png[/img]


I am [i]REALLY REALLY REALLY[/i] excited to see what insane skyboxes people come up with.



[h1]Changelog[/h1]
- Changed .zeeplevel file format from CSV to JSON
- Added a skybox editor
- Added a monthly automatic reboot to the Zeepkist servers, which should keep everything running smoothly. The reboot happens every first monday of the month. [i]After the reboot, it may take a bit longer to load workshop levels, but this is normal and should resolve itself after a while.[/i]
- Added "disable block collisions" checkbox in the extended block properties panel
- Fixed code new roman doesn't support japan text
- Fixed servermessage text alignment issue
- Propbably fixed an issue with loading levels on game start
- Fixed a streetlamp rendering issue in level editor
- Added 3 new primitives 


[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
- Gift counter doesn't work on A-01 in online multiplayer
- Splits sometimes don't show up
- [strike]Level names don't show up in online multiplayer[/strike]


[h1]New Roadmap!![/h1]

I also made a new roadmap, for people that are interested in that sort of thing!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/6f3f7ee2e76d3289724e0ab64a253a82e33f8306.png[/img]


[h1]Happy Zeepkisting!![/h1]

As with any update, things are likely to break and I'll be hard at work over the coming time to fix any issues and bugs that pop up.

Things are especially likely during this update because it's such a technically intensive change.
- The entire savefile system got overhauled
- Save/load system got updated
- Server got updated
- An entire custom skybox system was added

So please be patient while I work through everything!! :D

[b]If you notice any bugs, make a bug report on the Zeepkist Discord: [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord[/url], making sure to follow the instructions in the #bugs channel![/b]

I'll see you all around B-)

HAPPY ZEEPKISTING!!


[h1]v17p1:[/h1]
- Fixed level names not working
- Splitscreen now also listens to camera settings

notes.title: Level Contest - Slow Motion
notes.notes:
Season 6: Theme 2

[h3][b]THEME:[/b] Slow Motion[/h3]

Build a level where the player never goes above 100 speed!

Looking for ideas? Try a compact layout to make the most of the limited speed; use tight corners that feel smooth at lower speeds; get creative with elevation changes to control the player's speed.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask them in the discussion thread of this news post! Good luck, and happy building!

[h3][b]DEADLINE[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Your track should be complete and submitted by [b]Sunday, 6th April 2025 at 18:00 BST[/b]
[*] Submissions will be combined into a single workshop item after the deadline above
[/list]

[h3][b]SUBMISSION RULES[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] You can only submit one level (you can modify or replace your submission as much as you like until the deadline)
[*] Level collaborations are permitted (Maximum of 3 players per level. This counts as a level submission for each individual creator. Please name/mention collaborators when submitting)
[*] Level author name [b]MUST[/b] contain the submitters' Steam (or Discord) username
[*] The name of the level [b]MUST[/b] start with "ZSL - " (e.g "ZSL - My Level")
[/olist]

[h3][b]THEME RULES[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*]Level [b]MUST[/b] keep the player under 100 speed
[*]Level [b]MUST NOT[/b] have the player go faster than 100 speed. Use the Slower (red X) block to control and cap the maximum speed if you think someone could go faster than 100 speed on a section of your track
[/olist]

[h3][b]LEVEL RULES[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*]Scaling track pieces is permitted
[*]Level [b]MUST[/b] follow any theme requirements set above
[*]Level [b]MUST[/b] be [b][i]under[/i] 4000 blocks[/b]
[*]Level [b]MUST[/b] have an author time [b]above 20 seconds[/b]
[*]Level [b]MUST[/b] have an author time [b]under 60 seconds[/b]
[*]Level [b]MUST[/b] have [b][i]at least[/i] 3 checkpoints[/b]. Consider adding additional checkpoints for split timing or where it would prevent a cut, as cuts do not make for good tournament tracks!
[*]Level [b]MUST NOT[/b] have risky or hidden finishes/shortcuts (e.g blind shortcuts or using no-collision/invisible/logic blocks to hide a secret path that is [b]NOT[/b] the intended route)
[/olist]

[h3][b]HOW TO SUBMIT YOUR LEVEL[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.com/servers/zeepkist-706615492634476664]Official Discord server[/url]
[*] Upload the level to the Steam Workshop
[*] Link the workshop item in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/706615492634476664/1340720274735108188]theme's thread in [b]#level-submissions[/b][/url]

Don't have Discord? You can submit your entry by linking your workshop item in the comments section of this announcement post!
[/olist]

[h3][b]WINNERS & PRIZES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Up to 15 of the submitted levels will be used for the next Zeepkist Super League event

[list]
[*]Players of all skill ranges should be able to finish your level.
[*] The more playable your level is, the more likely your level will be chosen!
[/list]
[*] The community will vote on their favourite maps from the theme once submissions close
[*] Top 4 in the community votes for Best Decor and Best Track Layout will each win:

[list]
[*] A special soapbox cosmetic in-game.
[*] A `Level Contest Winner` role (Discord only)
[*] 3,000 chat EXP in our Discord server (Discord only)
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]BANNER CONTEST[/b][/h3]
We're also hosting a themed banner contest for our Discord server banner image where you can win a special paintbrush soapbox!! 

The theme is [b]Spring[/b] and ends at the same time as this level contest!! [url=https://discord.com/channels/706615492634476664/1034982513304666222]View the banner contest event details on Discord[/url]

- Akane

notes.title: Level Contest - Narrow (Theme Rules Updated 18/02/2025)
notes.notes:
Season 6: Theme 1

[h3][b]THEME:[/b] Narrow[/h3]

Build a level with a maximum width of 3 blocks!! (3 1x1 blocks wide)

Looking for ideas? How about creating a side-scroller inspired level; playing with verticality; or a twisting course down a gentle slope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/f6d29390a8255ab94aa71d1f51ae2e5bf7e684ce.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/3c765b94a43cac08454a977a745b4cda0792fcd0.png[/img]

[h3][b]CHANGES TO THEME RULES[/b] (17th Feb 2025)[/h3]

Due to confusion amongst the community regarding the ability to change the direction of the track (as shown in the example track layout shown here on the 16th of Feb). We held an open vote to gather your opinions on how to proceed with this theme's contest and received 86 votes. 

47% preferred to remove the ability to change the direction of the 3-wide track from the theme rules. 10% preferred to allow only 1 change in direction (e.g a single 90 degree change like the previous L-shaped example track layout) and 43% preferred to keep the original rules of allowing any number of direction changes.

[h4][b]Previous Theme Rule[/b][/h4]
[list]
[*]Level [b]MUST[/b] be no wider than 3 blocks (3 unscaled 1x1 blocks wide). The level does not need to be a straight line, but must maintain the maximum width throughout, for example your track can change directions on a 45deg/90deg angle (or any other angle/curve)
[/list]

[h4][b]New Theme Rule[/b][/h4]
[list]
[*]Level [b]MUST[/b] be no wider than 3 blocks (3 unscaled 1x1 blocks wide on the default 16 grid scale) in the same continuous direction.
[*]The level does not need to be 3 blocks wide the entire time - it can be as narrow as you need.
[*]The level can have jumps - it does not need to be an unbroken straight line.
[/list]

If you have any questions, feel free to ask them in the discussion thread of this news post!

[h3][b]SEASON 6 CHANGES[/b][/h3]

We've made a few tweaks to the level contests for Season 6:

[list]
[*] Adjusted the baseline maximum author time to [b]60 seconds[/b] (reduced from 75 seconds)
[*] Adjusted the required checkpoints to [b]3 checkpoints[/b] (increased from 2 checkpoints)
[/list]

[h1]Hey everyone!![/h1]

Annoying news!

Steam broke the authenticator in the build pipeline and now I can't publish new updates to the main Zeepkist branch anymore.

In simple words: I can't update the game at the moment!

This is really annoying because I need to push an update ([i]v16p50[/i]) that fixes some broken physics.


[h1]But there's a solution!![/h1]

I uploaded v16p50 to a Beta Branch, where you can still access it! It just takes a little bit of effort to get to it:

- Step 1:

[b]Right click on Zeepkist in Steam, and go to Properties:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/68eb0d118cf08bca06bd393a66c7887aa942f2b1.png[/img]


- Step 2:

[b]Go to "Betas", and enter code V16HOTFIXBRANCH[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/c4a4f97597d53760a3c185f90fc7ef4568421a69.png[/img]

[h3]V16HOTFIXBRANCH[/h3]


- Step 3:

[b]Click this button:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/d98d3ec6078511a59576f5a9c93e12d6f8c40237.png[/img]


- Step 4:

[b]You should now be in the v16-hotfix branch![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/ad3b968ee4ea0e713ac34ffac00c514408ccbc26.png[/img]


- Step 5:

[b]Close the settings menu and verify Zeepkist looks like this now:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/5b1734d20e6fbaa81124bb89b6730665827fca36.png[/img]


- Step 6:

[b]Play Zeepkist! Everything should work normally from here on out :)[/b]


[h1]What's next?[/h1]

The Steam authenticator has been broken for over 8 hours, which is very strange. I've sent Steam a support ticket asking if they could look into it.

In the meantime, we'll have to use the v16-hotfix branch!

I wish this didn't happen on the day I'm launching a free demo and a DLC but hey Steam moves in mysterious ways...

Happy Zeepkisting!!!

notes.title: Free Demo + Bobo Tires DLC
notes.notes:
[h1]HELLO EVERYONE[/h1]

[h2]IT'S TIME FOR NEW THINGS!! :D[/h2]

I'm going to release a free Zeepkist demo AND a new paid DLC, on the same day!

You can expect these to become available on [b]November 20, 2024[/b], right in time for the holiday season! :D

Now, let me go over the details to both of these!


[h1]>>> Zeepkist Free Demo <<<[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/028a692dc080385bed8b94390e0066d4aa718526.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320860/Zeepkist_Demo/?beta=0]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320860/Zeepkist_Demo/?beta=0[/url]

[h2]Zeepkist is getting a free demo!![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/a19905fbd9ce1c3878b1fd43f8f31c08782d5d67.png[/img]

The free demo will feature:

[list]
[*][b]16 Adventure Levels[/b]
[*][b]48 Cosmetics[/b]
[*][b]Full Splitscreen Support[/b]
[/list]

I've selected levels that showcase Zeepkist's mechanics and most of them should be pretty easy, however towards the end of the adventure demo I've included some harder levels to showcase those as well!

Most of these levels should be great for splitscreen as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/37daaf3742d1dceda82d1149375ee06ac22dd586.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/3dede1d5da86fc1b27f22b70f5dbd99e6655e42b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/9428a7e09fe6c89e055e5798e2daf7a180b2c68f.jpg[/img]

I hope the demo will introduce Zeepkist to many many people who would otherwise might never have given it a chance, as well as giving splitscreen gamers on a budget a really neat little racing game! :D

Fun fact: When Zeepkist first launched it had 24 adventure levels, compared to the 16 of the free demo.


[h1]>>> Bobo Tires DLC <<<[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/3f5ec30a134886f88f93d0674c66b75d1d3f0687.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316260/Zeepkist__BOBO_Tires_DLC/?beta=0]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316260/Zeepkist__BOBO_Tires_DLC/?beta=0[/url]

[h2]Zeepkist is finally getting a new DLC![/h2]

Many many people have been wondering when I might release the next DLC, but I always felt Zeepkist was still a little bit too unfinished to warrant another DLC.

However, with the recent release of v16, and especially the rollout of the many many cosmetics that can be unlocked through gifts, I figured it was time to spend some time making another DLC! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/4e8cb007ed617c526b547a2ca0e0aa7b37e69ad0.jpg[/img]

The Bobo Tires DLC is all about Bobo Tires, a tire and rim manufacturer from Japan that's renowned for making sick wheels for the entire zeepworld! And this DLC will feature 9 awesome wheel designs and 3 cool cars from Japan!

The full list of cosmetics is as follows:

[list]
[*][b]9 New Wheels[/b]
[*][b]Each wheel comes in 3 variants: Road, Race, and Race Thick[/b]
[*][b]Each wheel variant will come in 64 different colors[/b]
[*][b]3 New Zeepkists:[/b]
[*][b]1979 Watanabe Camel (The Kei Truck)[/b]
[*][b]1988 Yudi 700R[/b]
[*][b]2023 Taniuchi Chizu[/b]
[*][b]10 sweet Bobo glasses[/b]
[*][b]8 amazing Bobo hats[/b]
[*][b]16 incredible Bobo paragliders[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/1df596b5172a54bc436108f7bea780e1557519e7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/5419ada54c90d73ee247d09e49a51a97519efebf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/38de1dec976e9481f481cfa5727206e813438296.jpg[/img]

With the Bobo Tires DLC you can support Zeepkist development AND look super epic, all at the same time! :D


[h1]Closing Thoughts[/h1]

Like mentions, these will become available on [b]November 20, 2024[/b], in about two weeks from this news post going live.

I hope the demo will attracts lots of new players and friends, and I hope existing Zeepkist players will love the new DLC!

Looking towards the future, December will have the December Gift Hunt, so that's going to be lots of fun as well!

Now, I've got to get back to developing games & making Zeepkist updates!! :D

Happy Zeepkisting!!

notes.title: Zeepkist Beautiful Beta - Version 16, Patch 36 & 37
notes.notes:
Patch 36:

- Added a golf ball, it uses the same physics as the small football
- Updated XG-01, XG-02, XG-03, and XG-04 to have golf balls instead of footballs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/3ca8e356f65aabcb3919db38882cb09b0729e421.jpg[/img]

Patch 37:

- Added a new property to ball spawners, which acts like gate behavior like you see on other logic gates.

The options are
[list]
[*] [b]Any Enters[/b]: Ball gets dropped any time a physics object enters the trigger
[*] [b]First Enters[/b]: Ball gets dropped any time a physics object enters the trigger, and no other physics objects are in the trigger
[*] [b]Any Exits[/b]: Ball gets dropped any time a phyiscs object exits the trigger
[*] [b]Last Exits[/b]: Ball gets dropped any time a phyics object exits the trigger, and there are no other physics objects left in the trigger
[/list]

Should give you all a bunch more control of logic :)

It should not affect existing ball spawners, because the default option (Any Enters) is the same way ball spawners worked previously.

notes.title: Zeepkist v16 - The Sound Update
notes.notes:
[h1]V16 – The Sound Update
[/h1]


[h2]Introduction[/h2]


9 months ago to the day, I stopped work on v15 update patch releases, and opened a new branch in the Zeepkist Github repository: “Yannic-2021.3.10f-v16”

The first thing I did was work on the new reflections. They were already in place in some fashion, hidden in a secret menu and not really implemented all that well. So that was a low-hanging fruit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/ae11c45b25eb8dc1dcb9aea929e8aceac270800c.png[/img]

From there I moved on to fixing S-Bends, and then I added the FMOD audio framework and ported all existing Unity sounds to that. Then Monorails, and from there, the development of v16 was well underway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/aeeddbbc472ae8ea37660e1a88c32d5919fc6dac.png[/img]

I added physics-based balls, icons to level editor block thumbnails, implemented a crude logic system (more on this later), a Netherlands-inspired set of train station blocks, then offroad wheels, a garage, flying, etc and etc and etc and etc. I’ll attempt to list everything in a changelog later on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/7cd47fdfaa00ea3f96a9b37f58c9e68e2bff1b7d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/ac7391c1e1af40faa54551505abd45b9062a25a7.png[/img]

The issue with implementing all of these beautiful systems is that they needed to be supplemented with beautiful content.

The new Zeepkist mechanics needed new levels to showcase them, and the garage which allowed you to change them needed many many more cosmetics. It’s no wonder that the amount of cosmetics more than triples with v16.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/6537f74ee5075e54158a84fc96f1bf24e2a208e2.jpg[/img]

The new cosmetics, to make matters worse, then needed a whole new way of being unlocked. So many many hours went into creating “gifts” you can find in levels, which unlock a cosmetic.

In the final few weeks of v16 development, most of that time was spent finding neat places in existing adventure levels to hide cool gifts!

But I’m not here to complain! I think the gifts mechanic will add a whole new dynamic to playing the adventure mode. And that’s not to mention you can even unlock the gifts in splitscreen and online.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/92cc1e4848cccd7e839cfb89aa77aa1c9ed65e32.jpg[/img]

So without much further ado, I have one more feature announcement to make & then it’s on to the changelog!




[h2]Logic Blocks[/h2]


These balls:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/280f4c722852dd1f2eb75db95d71b517ada1e197.jpg[/img]

...were not added just because I wanted to put balls in the game.

They serve a vital purpose, actually!

Namely: Physics objects trigger logic blocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/39dcf22c86d5a6a92414980f410e4eee34e40b05.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/17776dad99b613d3e560df2cf98f7d7b738edca2.jpg[/img]

Logic blocks are very very simple.

There’s one or two triggers. When a physics object hits those triggers, they do some very simple math. And depending on the outcome, a block opens (disappears) or closes (appears).

The double-input logic gates have all the common logical operations: AND, OR, XOR, etc. And the single-input gates can function as simple buffers, inverted buffers, or latches.

Then there’s a final special logic block, which instantiates a new ball whenever its trigger gets hit. This can be used for creating new “signals”.

It’s then up to level creators to design pathways for physics objects to move from gate to gate, or for the player’s zeepkist to interact with them.

Fans and boosters can be used to move things along, and when you find there’s too much friction in your levels, you can simply use ice versions of all the different ball types!

There’s actually 4 logic-based “Zeepkist Golf” adventure levels which use logic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/50b54ac13be71232eaa2111f13b58e99b0b10f5f.jpg[/img]

You need to put a small football into the golf hole, before you can access the finish. If you don’t put the football in the hole, a gate will block your path.

I’m extremely confident that people will find many creative ways to use these, and many more different ways to completely break the game with it.

So go out and dive into the editor and check them out!! They’re probably my favorite feature of all of v16.

And I’ve kept them secret for at least a whole half a year ;)




[h2]Changelog[/h2]


Note: 9 months is a long time, and my record keeping is not extremely reliable! It’s very possible I’ll forget to mention one or two features/changes!

Fixed:
- Online shuffle now works nicely
- Particles are now more performant
- S-Bends didn’t fit together nicely
- Made D-07 author time easier
- Mouse sensitivity no longer tied to framerate
- Inspector Scrollbar is now twice as sensitive
- All paint particles now have correct color
- Editor movement gizmo now always faces camera
- Camera doesn’t move up/down anymore when going into grab mode in level editor
- Some Level Editor UI elements are slightly smaller now
- Level 01 (etc) are now called Level A-01 (etc)
- Various other things that were broken, probably
- Zeepkist is now v16 instead of v15


Added:
- FMOD Audio Framework
- A bunch of extra sounds
- A new garage
- Realtime Reflections [i](not raytracing, it’s old reflection-probe tech)[/i]
- New intro scene
- Monorail
- Train Station Blocks

- Autosaves and Backups shortcuts in “Load Levels”
- Change Camera hotkeys
- A thing that pops up and says you have mods installed

- Icon Blocks
- “Count as Checkpoint” options on status-changer blocks
- Invert Steering block

- Free Play level select UI now accepts mouse input
- Level Editor loading panel can now sort by date modified
- Whole bunch of weird wallride/tube transitions
- More S-Bend blocks
- Logic Blocks
- Rounded Cube Primitives
- More Primitives in general
- More rock blocks
- Oversteer/Broken Wheels Indicator UI
- Speed is now shown alongside time at checkpoints
- Note Block
- Horns
- Level Editor now shows Block and Folder IDs
- Braking makes you stick to monorails
- Traffic bump blocks
- More block thumbnails now have icons
- Boosters now have options “Affect Objects/Soapbox”
- Removed the Zeeprooms
- More bricks paint

- You can now view commands online if you press F1
- Selection helpers when selecting boosters/fans
- Online name color setting

- Level Editor Music [i](Thank u Duncan <3)[/i]
- FOV Settings

- A frog to some Zeepkist System Messages

- You can click on people’s names online to go to their steam page
- Faster downloading of workshop levels in online [i](experimental, might need to be reverted if it breaks stuff)[/i]
- Level Editor now has options for scaling blocks [i](this was a lot of work :D)[/i]

Well.

I hope that covers everything!

That just leaves me to say...

[b]HAPPY ZEEPKISTING!!!!![/b]

And I will see you all in the next update!!! <3

If something does break, please let me know on my Discord! [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord[/url]

notes.title: Zeepkist v16 - Release Date
notes.notes:
[h1]HI EVERYONE[/h1]

Zeepkist v16 has been in development for uhhhh about 6 or 7 months now, I've kind of lost track exactly. [i]edit: I've just checked! v16 development started in October!! That's almost [b]9 months!!!![/b][/i]

But it makes it the biggest update Zeepkist has had [i]ever![/i]


[h1]Price Increase[/h1]

It also happens to be the most important Zeepkist yet, because with the addition of a lot of sounds, I finally feel it's time to move Zeepkist from its [b]Awesome Alpha[/b] stage into the [b]Beautiful Beta[/b] stage! :D

[i]edit: It's not full release yet, Zeepkist will remain in Early Access![/i]

And with that, as I've long promised, I plan to do a price increase. [b]I'm not ready to reveal the exact sum yet[/b], Steam is still verifying my price change proposal, but it's not going to be an insane amount either way. Along with the price increase will also come regional price adjustments based on exchange rates, which are today a bit different than they were 3.5 years ago when Zeepkist first launched!

It DOES mean, that Zeepkist is currently as cheap as it's probably going to be for quite a while!!

But for that price increase you'll also get something in return, of course!

Without going into details, Zeepkist v16 will:
- Go from [b]77[/b] adventure levels to [b]113[/b] adventure levels!
- Go from [b]1622[/b] level editor blocks to [b]2284[/b] blocks!!
- Go from [b]462[/b] cosmetics to [b]1624[/b] cosmetics! That's [b]1180 new cosmetics!!![/b]

And not to forget, Zeepkist first launched at it's 10 euro price-point with only [b]24[/b] levels, [b]130[/b] blocks, and [b]less than 100[/b] cosmetics. A price increase was well in order :D

Of course, there's many many many other things Zeepkist v16 is getting, but I'm going to have to spend a couple of hours compiling a changelog for all of those...

I hope it will be able to sustain Zeepkist development for a long time to come, and many games beyond :)


[h1]Release Date[/h1]

Enough talk of money! When is Zeepkist v16 going to be available??

WELL (In case nothing goes terribly wrong!!)

Zeepkist v16 is releasing on [b]Monday, June 24[/b]!

That's [b]NEXT WEEK[/b]

notes.title: The Road to v16 - Zeepkist Devlog Part 6
notes.notes:
[h1]Zeepkist Devlog[/h1]

Hey everyone!!

If you've been following along on [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]the Discord[/url] you may have been keeping track of some recent developments!

You may also have read the previous devlog and been waiting for more!

It's been a while since part 5 (I'm really bad at doing these at any regular interval), but work on the update has been steadily progressing. In fact, I'd say this update is about 95% done so we're getting really really close to the end!

So anyway I thought it was time for devlog 6!!


[h1]Scaling!![/h1]

SO, scaling has been a "hidden" feature in Zeepkist ever since it launched. Blocks, when saved, also save their size. This meant that by file editing, and later by modding, it was possible to scale blocks. No doubt you've played workshop levels with feature up or down scaled blocks!

With v16, scaling will be an official Zeepkist feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/2c2c2bf8ea2f9145b4e6d6f3500845d90f5776c8.jpg[/img]

Blocks have a whole new menu accessed by this blue button in the top right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/801b103265651b4855a182e8439566be91e4cac6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/c2c40724981d20deff735f347221c58970c854ab.jpg[/img]

In this menu you can change the block's Transform values (position, rotation, size), as well as quickly change a block's scale with the press of a few buttons!



One example of something that will now be really easy in v16 will be making signs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/051d4a65b3dd539897c2cc4a39c2e5314ae336e9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/608284a0a9215dc50f962e2c2ba40403fc7304e7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/04ede869f9d370f632734211022a4c3bd8c1b628.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/4ff3907b2de622d1f8a924a94b09c05119db44c1.jpg[/img]



Scaling also works on particle emitters and lights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/71e5cd804524716039df26fce3a42c30c2f72ac8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/a1ecb5996f301f1cc605aa6d218f79b58538c8b2.jpg[/img]



Speaking of lights... v16 gets a "custom light emitter" block!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/ada4e5a4a67b7290618bafd60f092db18c991cfd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/62b7f3688b7d7133381c1521139a6a571494fc38.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/eccd70512fb14992fa43b276c9d2dc62fe3cb779.jpg[/img]



And finally, when it comes to the level editor: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/87bef5cee3766e9af5f2e9fbf9b098b508920dd3.jpg[/img]



[h1]More Cosmetics!![/h1]

There's currently two majors things left to do for this update to be ready:

[list]
[*]Some sounds
[*]Add a whooole bunch of cosmetics
[/list]

And adding cosmetics in and of itself is not that hard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/32ddaf3872b7c35c84e5fc65a4ad378a1fa2be6e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/67d3b77da6570adf1f5e12ce93332bd6ad1ba83f.jpg[/img]

The issue I ran into was that Zeepkist is going to have more cosmetics than new adventure levels will allow.



So I had to get creative...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/875f4c500a1cf6f492cee14446b92b1c9c612b95.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/65d20607a9813426577a655da830617a5ceb946b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/eaa30ed95ffca27b5ac1e829b836b5de6159bd49.png[/img]

I will be hiding gifts in levels, which unlock cosmetics!

These will be hidden in all levels, not just the new ones, and there's still quite a few cosmetics I need to hide, so the eventual list will get pretty big!



I'm also going to give achievements to players for finding all gifts of a type, and I'll be awarding achievements for people who manage to get all medals in adventure mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/602b9eeac4f34a291e89c509711dcde3b22eee66.png[/img]

So lots of good stuff coming all your ways!! Just a bit of work still to get it all done and polished up and presentable :D



[h1]The End[/h1]

[i]That's it for this devlog!! I hope you enjoyed the little behind-the-scenes insight and I hope all of you are as excited for Zeepkist Version 16 as I am!!

If you want to be even more up to date on Zeepkist development, you can [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]join the Discord![/url]

Happy Zeepkisting!![/i]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/3ce1d218b671421e27dfd05fcac807caaafbb43f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Deck Bug - Stuck at 100% Downloading
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Over the past few days I've received some bug reports where players on Steam Deck get stuck on the "Downloading Workshop Levels - 100%" screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/4241aa962c154d9b2b4da3828ccd4aa24743c99f.png[/img]

I've asked for their player logs and found out that this is caused by the Steam API throwing weird errors... but only on Steam Deck.

These issues don't occur on Windows, even though the code is the exact same.

This leads me to believe that it's an issue that I can't solve on my own, and so I've made a support ticket on Steam's special developer page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/27ab515525fa095d48f6347013b33f3c5e0020ff.png[/img]

I hope we can figure out what's going on and causing these issues. I'll post an update when I've got news to report.

Until then, I'm afraid this bug will keep popping up on Steam Deck :(

I hope I've informed you all well and that this issue gets resolved soon!

- Yannic

notes.title: The Road to v16 - Zeepkist Devlog Part 5
notes.notes:
[h1]Zeepkist Devlog[/h1]

Hey everyone!!

If you've been following along on [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]the Discord[/url] you may have been keeping track of some recent developments!

You may also have read the previous devlog and been waiting for more!

It's been a while since part 4, but work on the update has been steadily progressing. So I thought it was time for devlog 5!!


[h1]The New Garage[/h1]

This entire devlog is about showing off the new v16 garage, as well as the increased cosmetics options you'll have!


Currently, in Zeepkist v15, you have to enter adventure mode to be able to change your cosmetics. In v16, you'll be able to do it straight from the main menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/4580ef7cac764f6ce461e41ad896083f843da394.jpg[/img]


Cosmetics are now grouped by folders, which should make it a lot easier to find the specific cosmetic you're looking for!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/1f78d651bb291b196ffdb4cc40442c2b6f34564d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/06b0063d7e4045e4441f48e79877c2a5a9da0533.jpg[/img]


We've also got a bunch of new types of cosmetics!

Hats and Glasses have been split up into separate categories, so you'll be able to mix and match to really find your own style!

With the trash button you're also able to now REMOVE your hat (or glasses) entirely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/ec515d9d0cacdbc3d641cebc39eb0d347ec7692d.jpg[/img]


You'll now also be able to select the front and rear wheels of your Zeepkist, overriding the Zeepkist's default wheels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/96dd7404eaac4f1527a2fc67b233be4cd452020c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/a0e6eb9699e84016f4463166292b26515882b658.jpg[/img]


The character color picker has also received an upgrade, now allowing you to change each color of your character individually!

And instead of your online chat name color being derived from your body color, you'll now be able to select your own custom color through the online settings menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/49c0cb6ac015fc0167d8aa5ebdf9006ba8dc8d6b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/fdcf2821f383297bbe48a5e56283b57551b2cf4d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/955d74b33fdd4c853edd5347625621415c3981a4.png[/img]


And last but not least, here's what selecting a paraglider looks like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/9c593b379495810da4d0416fd2488a3556206bc1.jpg[/img]


[h1]The End[/h1]

[i]That's it for this devlog!! I hope you enjoyed the little behind-the-scenes insight and I hope all of you are as excited for Zeepkist Version 16 as I am!!

If you want to be even more up to date on Zeepkist development, you can [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]join the Discord![/url]

Happy Zeepkisting!![/i]

[h1]Offroad Wheels[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/b309e717467b025c23df3c4448c16c06828a6e03.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/b50e504b139065612630ba7a443f493b56fd29a0.jpg[/img]

Offroad Wheels will are, as the name suggests, for going off road!

They provide much lifted suspension, bigger wheels, and completely different handling mechanics! Off road, you will have [i]more[/i] grip, while on tarmac you'll actually have [i]less[/i] grip!

But don't just take my word for it! Here's a video showcasing it!

[previewyoutube=F6IUoEbBmTY;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Flying[/h2]

In the same vein, v16 is also adding FLYING!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/a7c82079367e95e2e308914a9dae1e01d6773e37.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/8fc84a18c5d781d5e52f9d18957fefe74607cd4d.jpg[/img]

Flying mechanics attach a paraglider to your zeepkist and allow you to soar the great blue yonder!

You roll with left and right, and pitch with arms up and braking! An additional analog input axis is also added for controller players.

As with offroad wheels, here's a video showcasing flying!

[previewyoutube=F4VBCUXWWjI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]The Nitty-Gritty[/h2]

These two new mechanics use the same "vehicle state" system as the soap wheels.

That means: You drive through a "changer" gate, and your zeepkist mechanics change! You drive through another one, and your mechanics change to that new one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/bb2e26a9c2cc2df495344ddddf8aa2815ec04228.jpg[/img]

A "reset" gate in this sense can be seen as the "default mechanics" gate.

When paragliding, colliding your paraglider with world geometry causes it to "detach", which also resets you to default zeepkist mechanics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/63418c8cbe94a2bc47b1d98ac0ac8be10810fc18.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/acb6c94d0f10b5ead99efe5a4e770c8d7f47a9c7.jpg[/img]


[h2]Other Gates[/h2]

Then there's also another type of "changer" gate!

These don't involve the vehicle state system and have other effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/d7648d8f3adef57d179856ec88684e43d07a281a.jpg[/img]

From left to right:
- Invert Steering
- Invert Arms Up/Brake
- Change to Camera 1
- Change to Camera 3

You're familiar with camera changer blocks, these have been in-game since forever. The new "invert controls" blocks should make for pretty fun mind-breaking maps :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/0f48af41def8a26339a83288ecfe4f12f0d4372d.png[/img]

Another neat thing v16 is getting is the ability to let every gate also act as a checkpoint! With a single toggle in the level editor inspector panel, the gates turn green and the game will view them as checkpoints!


[h2]Camera Controls[/h2]

Zeepkist v16 is also making an addition to the camera changer blocks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/82e7adf94b73c161fda7a39abce0f90385d70a15.png[/img]

In the settings you will now find an option to ignore camera changer blocks, and to set your preferred "first person view" camera mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/bf2df3159a7e49f4817215a913c460489c257a77.png[/img]

Zeepkist is also getting proper camera controls now, with multiple new bindings in the input bindings menu to play with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/cf7fe6034c3d4bec3fec88dac211bd7b4f3c8f60.jpg[/img]



[h1]The End[/h1]

[i]That's it for this devlog!! I hope you enjoyed the little behind-the-scenes insight and I hope all of you are as excited for Zeepkist Version 16 as I am!!

If you want to be even more up to date on Zeepkist development, you can [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]join the Discord![/url]

Happy Zeepkisting!![/i]

notes.title: Zeepkist: Crash 2D is out now!!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey all!![/h1]

I'm really excited to announce that Zeepkist: Crash 2D has finally launched!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/79edacca04ec838dd367d5878d027bd0d2a871dd.png[/img]

Zeepkist: Crash 2D is a web game that's available on Poki.com!

[h1][url=https://poki.com/en/g/zeepkist-crash-2d]Play Zeepkist: Crash 2D!![/url][/h1]

The mechanics are similar to "dismount" type games: You crash your zeepkist and try to rack up as many points as possible, which you can use to buy new zeepkists, hats, levels, and obstacles!

It's entirely free, and is monetized by letting players watch ads!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/af6cd4ec66264c4b084f3df63740c1f517e174bf.png[/img]


[h1]What? Why? What about regular Zeepkist? :O[/h1]

You probably have a bunch of questions! I'll try to answer a bunch of them, and if you have more, feel free to leave a comment!


[b]Q: What is this?[/b]
[i]A: A new game by me![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/c1c910eb0ebcf08d444c56d0d451a3ad2686eac8.png[/img]


[b]Q: Why did you make another game?[/b]
[i]A: Poki reached out to me about a year and a half ago to see if I was interested in publishing to web platforms. I didn't have anything to put on Poki at the time (Zeepkist itself is far too big for that of course).

Later, however, I was playing around with 2D physics and made this little game, and I decided to get in touch with Poki to see if they were interested in this little thing I was making. And they were!

My biggest motivation for putting time and effort into this is because I'm curious if small games-on-the-side like this can make money, which I need to live. And I'm especially curious if this can give me an additional income stream that might be a bit more steady than Steam. It's also smart not to put all of your eggs into one basket.

Another, smaller, motivation is that I'm curious to see if this will raise Zeepkist "brand awareness". Maybe people will play Zeepkist 2D on Poki, google Zeepkist or come across it on Youtube, and decide to give Zeepkist a try![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/9b607f043926e0c1ca22a7849af0e2fa073fb638.png[/img]


[b]Q: Did this take time away from developing Zeepkist?[/b]
[i]A: Yes! Absolutely, solo-developing two games at the same time is not easy. But I hope it will pay off in the end and all be worth it :)[/i]


[b]Q: What's next?[/b]
[i]A: Back to work on Zeepkist v16! Development on Zeepkist continued throughout development of Zeepkist 2D, as you might have noticed from the devlogs and patches!

I'm curious to see how well Zeepkist 2D does. If it makes sense for me to make more web games I'll absolutely think about doing that. At the end of the day I still need to pay rent! :D[/i]



I hope that answers all of your questions! 

Go play Zeepkist 2D, tell your friends, and Happy Zeepkisting!!!

- Yannic

notes.title: The Road to v16 - Zeepkist Devlog Part 3
notes.notes:
[h1]Zeepkist Devlog[/h1]

Hey everyone!!

If you've been following along on [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]the Discord[/url] you may have been keeping track of some recent developments!

You may also have read the previous devlog and been waiting for more!

Well, I've been cooking this one for a while now! It's time for devlog 3!!


[h1]Monorails[/h1]

The keen observer might have noticed something, once or twice, in the background of Zeepkist's main menu.

Look at the very top of the image, behind the glass:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/f54a3bb2fa8c0027f148cf5e9ba1b6a76849a8f1.jpg[/img]

I've always been fairly secretive about the whole affair. It's been something I prototyped long ago and since then never had the time to actually implement.

Here's what it looks like in the Unity Editor:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/997c0702856d58f5a757dc9f07397fb049be12b2.png[/img]

For v16, I figured it was time to add this for real :)

IT'S MONORAIL TIME

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/a0f763fbf04fe7189725eb0fe208c31bcc2b4a11.jpg[/img]

[b]Monorails!

The ideal form of public transport!! Tried and tested in real life, their swag outperforms trains, their grace makes them preferable to airplanes, and their passenger-carrying capacity makes them an obvious winner over automobiles.

Zeepkist could not do without, of course.[/b]


[h2]Monorails[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/4fa93ccae6f908a77da66ac9a1c83f977fcf527b.jpg[/img]

Monorails come with dedicated monorail station blocks, which allow for easy access to player-enterable monorail cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/0e157f4aab632150c14d9ffce45cecebf124ea6a.jpg[/img]

Upon entering monorail cars, players can brake and a little anchor icon will display in the bottom of the screen. The anchor icon means that the player's Zeepkist is [i]connected[/i] to the monorail car beneath it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/29fe0dac64c11ff42cbb0427dd655fad6e1fcee7.jpg[/img]

This mechanic makes it possible for players to hop onto monorails, connect, and go through curves and over hills without any fear of falling off!

I've also decided to retrofit this new mechanic to sleds, which were a perfect candidate for this "connection" mechanic! No more falling out of sleds for you folks!! :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/2fe87226c67a89f10a2e10466a7c3b28734b1c18.png[/img]


[h2]Tunnels[/h2]

Next, I wanted to make sure that the new monorails meshed well with already existing Zeepkist blocks, so I made sure the following was possible:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/a2615516757306edbcb803562414dc44d136b7d0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/465d925928e1df810ac294aa750f63593afaaedb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/849e0153d05bf13af68f0f8d237fca369a3cec4a.jpg[/img]

Monorails can use bobsleigh tubes as tunnels!


[h2]Special Blocks[/h2]

Monorails also come with a couple of special blocks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/6745dad04b10ee41295d2919f384de4b9a32a4b8.jpg[/img]

There's a "horn" block which lets the monorail toot its horn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/3f7b408640b0a2827e6e4a5cc2115f1da6365928.jpg[/img]

And a buffer stop which will, naturally, not allow the monorail to continue.


[h2]Bankings[/h2]

Monorails also come with a couple of banked blocks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/130abae96ac01b803be405d0d76af7b7e9d2d7fd.jpg[/img]

These are especially useful for making it easier to dismount monorails. Zeepkists will easily roll off of tilted monorails!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/e409c25b7a8a085eabde4219ec9e5594a3cc0e42.jpg[/img]

On top of which, banked monorails are extremely radical to ride on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/9ffe82f5f326e211c8687cc1f36b465e76530608.jpg[/img]


[h2]Insanity[/h2]

Finally, monorails can go up and down!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/8e1406787133eb5c0554efb27afdf730d2a1a10c.jpg[/img]

And they can go further up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/bdd2f515c5b4527a7ec11b8668291c0dbd9023ac.jpg[/img]

...and down! Really, you can do whatever you want with monorails!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/f03f8f4918a01adc8e1fb9c1bd72cfcbcdcd2b0b.jpg[/img]


[h2]One Warning[/h2]

However! And I cannot stress this enough! All of these monorails are [b]100% physics based[/b]. They are not following any invisible splines or whatever. They exist in your level as rigidbodies with colliders, some forces applied, and nothing more!

[b]⚠️ This means they can derail! ⚠️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/c58fdf80f9f8af6d4198c3dd3a6b4918fc78e696.jpg[/img]

[b]They can even derail on perfectly regular looking track pieces, if you set their speed too high!![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/1070cee1dc3a3cf5731960f38a8c4fd78fdb609c.jpg[/img]

[b]⚠️ Their default speed, 100, works very smooth and stable, and should not cause any problems under regular use.

notes.title: The Road to v16 - Zeepkist Devlog Part 2
notes.notes:
[h1]Zeepkist Devlog[/h1]

Hey everyone!!

If you've been following along on [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]the Discord[/url] you may have been keeping track of some recent developments!

You may also have read the previous devlog and been waiting for more!

Well, wait no longer! Devlog part 2 is here!! :D


[h1]Fixing S-Bends[/h1]

SO, for the longest time, Zeepkist had a teeny tiny little very annoying issue with its S-Bends.

...They didn't fit together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/b28e50aedb1f4277259f015792678985b7f92dbf.jpg[/img]

The roads (pink) would fit together with the terrain pieces (checkerboard pattern on the side), but there was an issue:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/8e1066c45812807f505bc841aab7aa9e556bf64e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/122fdc314656bdcc5c8da92bf114fc762a025446.jpg[/img]

S-Bend road would leave a gap, and S-Bend terrain pieces would overlap and cause Z-Fighting.

And in a game where the entire level editor is based on blocks that fit together, blocks not actually fitting together is really annoying.

So for v16 I'm fixing that!

The issue is that when I made these S-Bends, I didn't consider aligning them to a "perfect" S-Bend. In the picture below you can see the perfect S-Bend as the orange line, with the track piece being the black wireframe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/6a840c2b91bda43a5f1f573721559396e869abc3.png[/img]

Luckily, the fix is generally pretty easy. Just recreate the pieces but this time using the perfect S-Bend as a guide!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/58983c7732c51ed640dd067480f07862adac5065.png[/img]

...All 26 different pieces of them...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/7b5ab37ff953c7cfd290353e6dac212e97ef788c.png[/img]

...And then making the 3 and 4 block long versions... :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/d68fc5c693b85cd8fa0ec034018fdc9815747b3d.png[/img]

Once that was done I could verify in Blender that they indeed fit with the S-Bend template AND with each other!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/6481e72847973b6310a7f34d932e07bb15e3f38c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/26f6a38136cab05343b5d6222bb3197eeb59053a.png[/img]

Then all I had to do was verify if they also fit together in Zeepkist, and yes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/3de29c63bdf139bf27bc41e6ba133135ce413feb.jpg[/img]

Roads fit together side by side!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/10e0591ef706e92f39eafa2eb77525800a97139a.jpg[/img]

And so do the terrain pieces!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/6522449947dcfd55f8a89216022a6cf2e0f54efe.jpg[/img]

Finally, S-Bend pieces make sense :)

But that's not all!

Seeing as I was working on S-Bends anyway, I figured I'd make a couple of new ones that I'd been missing in Zeepkist so far.


[h1]MORE S-Bends!![/h1]

First up we have these split S-Bends. We had a split-S bend before, as part of the "covered glass roads" track pieces, but that one was tilted at an angle and only had one special barrier type. Now we get 3 flat S-Bends in the regular road style :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/64c7ae5beff2525df228cf151a21a2535f4f6f8b.jpg[/img]

Next we have half S-Bends!

I can imagine these will be extremely useful for example when transferring from flat road to halfpipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/79f6fad1904120bfac089bc8f5c6eca9f50805b5.jpg[/img]

And finally we have sloped half S-Bends! :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/586744aed218a6513dd422485dc2506d18860d42.jpg[/img]

And that's about it for today's devlog!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/f3b8b4341228061e84d8205b8b3bf5f932c93c0c.jpg[/img]



[h1]The End[/h1]

[i]That's it for this devlog!! I hope you enjoyed the little behind-the-scenes insight and I hope all of you are as excited for Zeepkist Version 16 as I am!!

If you want to be even more up to date on Zeepkist development, you can [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]join the Discord![/url]

Happy Zeepkisting!![/i]




PS: Here's a sneak peek to a future devlog: 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/731e1ae9b1d88f3c83d9b963e1c18100569f15a6.png[/img]

notes.title: The Road to v16 - Zeepkist Devlog Part 1
notes.notes:
[h1]Zeepkist Devlog[/h1]

Hey everyone!!

If you've been following along on [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]the Discord[/url] you may have been keeping track of some recent developments!

You might also have noticed some small updates recently containing mostly bugfixes, a lot of which are actually things I fixed for the next update but decided to already make available right now because they're so helpful!

So I thought it might be fun to make a series of news post development logs to keep everyone up-to-date on what I'm working on!

Namely, I'm working on:


[h1]Zeepkist Version 16[/h1]

If you've been keeping track of Zeepkist's version numbering you might realize we're currently still on Version 15, but Patch [i][b]66[/b][/i]. That's quite a large patch number!

For a small history on Version 15, here's a couple of relatively big changes it contained:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/c5f6f1f9fb815f898fb504b016c5179ff4971d7c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/a7f4083954fb89e03fb0e1f78752911459660dfb.png[/img][/url]

- [b]v15p0:[/b] Ctrl-Z
- [b]v15p8:[/b] Purple neon & more block primitives
- [b]v15p10:[/b] Fog + Glass Fixed
- [b]v15p16:[/b] New spectator camera modes
- [b]v15p25:[/b] Feather Forcefields

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/8e66aaa8d3d970cc5b9fa167e3e1c922da75d3cf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/5f45e6cde77cd81aecc44bde14980ae37dbe4d32.png[/img][/url]

- [b]v15p34:[/b] Server Update
- [b]v15p35:[/b] More Server Update
- [b]v15p36:[/b] More More Server Update
- [b]v15p38:[/b] The Soap Update
- [b]v15p55:[/b] Faster Startup Loading

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/1dbb701b0f05f684e8f72cf922b6ed707c48880d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/e3f0318996a6ad3e12791035c95463b6d100d024.png[/img][/url]

All that while I'd been planning the Zeepkist v16 update, constantly just-not-getting-to-it. But now that's about to change!

Zeepkist v16 will be a [b]big[/b] update, and I intend for it to lift Zeepkist out of [i]"Alpha"[/i] and into [i]"Beta"[/i]. I'm planning to bump up the price of Zeepkist as well, seeing as Zeepkist today is a very very different game than it was back when Zeepkist v1 first launched.

So, time for the devlog! The first part will be about FMOD.


[h1]FMOD[/h1]

There's one big thing that makes Zeepkist still feel a little bit "in-development", and it's the fact that Zeepkist's sound is quite lacking.

There's no music in-game, except from the main menu, there's only a handful of sound effects, and everything combined makes the whole soundscape feel really unfinished. (And Zeepkist by extension).

The [i]why[/i] of that is two-part:

- Making sound effects and music is hard
- Actually implementing sound effects was also hard

The first makes sense: Recording clean audio isn't easy, finding the right sounds isn't easy, and making music isn't easy. This doesn't need a lot of explanation, but it's also something that can be overcome with effort, creativity, and a bunch of microphones.

The second one is more complex, and it boils down to one crucial flaw within Unity:
[b]Unity only supports one sound listener[/b].

This means that 3D sound can only be interpreted from one 3D location. Which is fine if you have a game with one local player. However Zeepkist supports 4-player split-screen, which means Zeepkist needs to support 4 different audio listeners.

My solution for this was a wholly custom sound framework that would calculate the distance between sound events and player cameras, and interpolate the sound's volume from that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/1dd129d628c511d018398da82f86affa5dd0e028.png[/img]

It [i]works[/i], but it's completely unscalable.

Every single new sound I added required me to dive into the codebase to manually add API endpoints to my audio system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/e243c75532507d2cfbca38561f399eff3b0af5de.png[/img]

What this meant was that any time I had to add a sound, it came with a huge amount of busiwork that really discouraged me from even starting on it. On top of that, I was planning to switch to a better system down the line anyway, so any effort I would put into it would go to waste.

And that's not even to mention complex sound effects such as changing wind volume and pitch based on Zeepkist velocity, which took even more work and tweaking and effort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/51ed3833e16f6cec96a0e0ae079ff21a779831d6.png[/img]

With v16, I'm finally upgrading to the better system I'd been planning to switch to all that time.

FMOD!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/fc2a45932d0e45fb6f80bb85dbb4f0955911d1da.png[/img]

FMOD is a third party audio framework which completely bypasses Unity's inbuilt system, and comes with a fully-fledged [i]Digital Audio Workstation[/i] designed specifically for videogames.

It's used by small indies and big studios alike, and just about everyone I talk about it has nothing but praise for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/cbd3efffe4c331fc4916e259b44603027a974736.png[/img]

FMOD also includes something they call "parameters", which are values that can be changed from in-game, and changes how the sound framework plays sounds.

For instance, the "wind" sound effect has a parameter called "speed", which is tied to sound volume and pitch all controlled from the comfort of FMOD itself. I don't have to code a single line of code for it, everything happens inside of FMOD and I just need to click and drag some things.

Another thing I love is the "multi-track event" or something like that. What it means is that I can assign multiple audio source files to a single audio event. From Zeepkist I can simply say "Hey FMOD play me a collision!" and then FMOD randomly picks one of the collision sound effects to play for me.

Again, zero programming required. It makes audio work blazingly fast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/2b1527a376338e0063236ea7bccc907ee846fd41.png[/img]

It also has a complete mixer-routing system in-place which allows me to assign audio events to specific groups which can have their volumes individually adjusted. Again all from inside FMOD without a line of code in sight.

The only code I type is "FMOD please do X or Y" and the rest happens automatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/660621a7473d1bcf61404c79592b1684e221da0f.png[/img]

Needless to say this whole thing makes it a LOT easier to add sound effects to Zeepkist, and shifts the entire burden to recording the sound effects themselves. It's basically a 50% decrease in effort at this point, and makes the whole game audio thing a lot nicer to work with.

I'm very excited to be using this a lot more :)


[h1]The End[/h1]

[i]That's it for this devlog!! I hope you enjoyed the little behind-the-scenes insight and I hope all of you are as excited for Zeepkist Version 16 as I am!!

If you want to be even more up to date on Zeepkist development, you can [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]join the Discord![/url]

Happy Zeepkisting!![/i]

notes.title: Zeepkist v15p55: Faster Startup Loading!!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi everyone!![/h1]

While working on v16 I was looking through the startup loading code and managed to do some optimizations!

And instead of waiting to include this in the bigger update way down the line I decided to release it as a small update instead!

Loading adventure levels and local levels should be considerably faster. Workshop level loading should also be faster but are still bottlenecked by some Steam API  calls.


[h2]Experimental: Faster Workshop Loading[/h2]

Included is an option in general settings to enable faster workshop loading:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38891205/7df6d495f9500e457aa0d03fe0c53c617979414c.png[/img]

The faster workshop loading implements different, faster, Steam API calls, as well as a custom local cache.

This is a bit untested and could break, so I've included it as an experimental setting that people can enable/disable as they please.

If you've got it enabled and run into a bug, please let me know on the Zeepkist Discord: [url=https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord]https://steelpan.dev/zk-discord[/url]

(Also, make sure any loading-related mods are disabled).


[h2]Other patch notes:[/h2]
- Awarded old level contest cosmetic
- Awarded first season 3 banner contest cosmetics
- v15p56: Removed a floating popo from main menu
- v15p57: Fixed an issue with the experimental loading
- v15p58: Small bit of backend safety code on experimental workshop loading


[i]Happy zeepkisting!!![/i]
